title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Customer Terms: Declining a Calibration
content:
**Who may decline.** A customer may decline an ADAS Sensor Calibrations calibration in writing only where the tier allows declination. On Front Radar Calibration and Multi-System Calibration orders the network does not release a vehicle with an uncalibrated radar, and the only alternative to the in-house calibration is the dealer sublet.

**Signed declination.** The customer's declination of the order is signed. The declination is read from the declination form on file for that same calibration order and its recorded status.

**Effect.** A declination is recorded before an attempt starts and is never charged. It lets the source repair or glass job complete without the calibration, and the declined systems are excluded from every workmanship warranty issued on the source work.

## By tier

| Tier | Customer may decline in writing |
|---|---|
| Dynamic Camera Calibration | yes |
| Static Camera Calibration | yes |
| Dual-Mode Camera Calibration | yes |
| Blind Spot Radar Calibration | yes |
| Front Radar Calibration | no — the alternative to in-house calibration is the dealer sublet |
| Multi-System Calibration | no — the alternative to in-house calibration is the dealer sublet |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical orders)

- A Static Camera Calibration order with a signed declination on file, no attempt yet started: the declination may be recorded; no charge arises from it.
- A Blind Spot Radar Calibration order whose customer has said by phone that they do not want the calibration, with no signed declination on file: the signed-declination condition is not met.
- A Front Radar Calibration order: the customer may not decline; the in-house calibration or the dealer sublet are the only routes to a calibrated radar.
